simulator.seeds: SeedSequence [42, fold_index, 0] for augmentation and [42, fold_index, 1] for the stress set

selection.rule: lowest mean-fold real validation log loss over the 7 development folds
selection.tie: equal when rounded to 4 decimals; simpler wins: baseline, then LR before LSTM, then arm A < B = C = D < E, then smaller lambda / w
selection.baseline_wins: stop before the reserved evaluation; no model is picked

rule.rule: lowest mean-fold real validation log loss over the 7 development folds
rule.tie: equal when rounded to 4 decimals; simpler wins: baseline, then LR before LSTM, then arm A < B = C = D < E, then smaller lambda / w
rule.baseline_wins: stop before the reserved evaluation; no model is picked
